requirements.title: Complete format reversion target, repeat reuse, mode preservation, and slash-like positioning
requirements.definition: At the complete format right parenthesis, format control terminates if no further item exists. If another item exists, it reverts to the beginning of the format item terminated by the last preceding right parenthesis that is not part of a DT edit descriptor, or to the first left parenthesis if there is no such preceding parenthesis. A repeat before the reversion parenthesis is reused, reversion itself does not change changeable modes, and file positioning is as for a slash edit descriptor.

pending.dt-parenthesis-excluded-from-target: Deferred until DT defined-I/O is registered, with exact planned oracle: define a scalar derived type whose formatted DT output writes exactly 'D'; internal WRITE to character(len=2) rec(2) with format '(DT(9),I1)' and items dt_value,1,dt_value,2 must expect rec(1)='D1' and rec(2)='D2'. The right parenthesis in DT(9) is excluded, so complete-format reversion falls back to the first left parenthesis and repeats the DT output on rec(2).

requirements.title: A reused portion on complete format reversion shall contain a data edit descriptor
requirements.definition: If complete-format reversion occurs, the reused portion shall contain at least one data edit descriptor.

pending.reused-portion-without-data-descriptor-r: Negative WRITE with a nonempty I/O list and format '(I1,("X"))' using two integer items. The whole format contains data edit descriptor I1, so 13.4 p2 is satisfied for the nonempty list; after the first item is consumed, complete-format reversion for the second item targets the last preceding parenthesized format item '("X")', whose reused portion has no data edit descriptor and therefore violates p9 only. Control changes the single property by adding a data edit descriptor to that reused portion, e.g. format '(I1,("X",I1))' with the same two integer items; no other rule is intentionally varied.
